newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bourse announces off-market disclosure rules.
newsitem.headline: Czech bourse announces off-market disclosure rules.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) released details on Tuesday of its plan to require the bourse's members to disclose off-market trades beginning on April 1.

As part of a continuing effort to improve transparency in Czech equities trading, the bourse said that the following types of trades must be registered with the PSE by 2 p.m. (1300 GMT) on the day the deal has been made, or on the next day if the transfer is made after the deadline:
- Transfers arising from lending securities or from settlement mistakes
All the above must be reported if the total turnover of the trade exceeds 200,000 crowns.
Results will be published between 4-5 p.m. (1500-1600 GMT) on the day that trades have been registered.
